items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: people like Symphony Sid, who was a very popular DJ, they knew I was going to be called by the draft board, so they started teasing me, even on the radio.

ctx.x: Korean War. I still had my 4-F from Boston. I told them, I said, “You don’t want – you don’t really like black people anyway. What you want with me?” I got rejected then. Because the guys were planning – I had just bought that new – that car. 1950. I think that was the Korean War. I was in Birdland playing with Charlie Parker. There were a couple drummers planning on what they would do if Roy Haynes went in. One drummer said he would take his gig with Bird, and the other said, “I’ll take his car.” In the…
how I knew they were still into music, they were selling records all over the world. That’s when I found out, early. Break time.
